_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Any pallet can have a description now, not just FPP pallets and pallets with no LPN: tap its LPN, then tap the Description box under it and type (for example what's on it, the labels or a PO number). It shows under the LPN and goes on the exports. The box still only opens by itself for FPP pallets and No LPN.
